title: OASIS STIX 2.1：亂序版本接收與同版本衝突隔離
titleEn: OASIS STIX 2.1: out-of-order version reception and conflicting-version quarantine
subcategoryTitle: 鑑識時間線、證據來源與可重現分析
subcategoryTitleEn: Forensic timelines, provenance and reproducible analysis
summary: 以物件ID加modified識別版本，固定來源身份政策，保存不可變歷史；對每次接收輸出advance、stale、duplicate或conflict決策及理由。
summaryEn: Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「固定版本鍵與來源政策」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Pin version keys and provenance policy: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若同鍵不同內容被任意選最後一份，衝突證據消失；若只按ID去重，新版本會被吞掉；分開測這兩種失敗，保留雙方內容雜湊。
對衝突停止自動採用並交接來源查證，對陳舊版本保留歷史但不回退狀態；本課不把情報物件自動轉成生產封鎖規則。
情報接收端依到達順序覆寫同ID物件，較舊版本晚到後讓已撤銷的物件復活；本課建立可重放版本狀態機，另處理同鍵不同內容。
optionsEn: Last-write selection for conflicting same-key content destroys conflict evidence. Deduplicating by ID alone discards genuine updates. Test these failures independently and preserve both content hashes when conflict occurs.

Suspend automatic adoption for conflicts and hand off provenance review. Retain stale versions in history without regressing active state; this lesson never converts intelligence objects automatically into production blocking rules.

An intelligence receiver overwrites objects by arrival order, letting a late older version revive a revoked object. Build a replayable version-state machine and separately quarantine different content claiming the same version key.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. An intelligence receiver overwrites objects by arrival order, letting a late older version revive a revoked object. Build a replayable version-state machine and separately quarantine different content claiming the same version key. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason.

knowledge.textEn: An intelligence receiver overwrites objects by arrival order, letting a late older version revive a revoked object. Build a replayable version-state machine and separately quarantine different content claiming the same version key.

knowledge.textEn: Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason.

knowledge.title: 教學輸入與單位
knowledge.text: 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 五個合成ID各有v1與v2，共10個不同版本；A到D先收v2再v1，E先v1再v2。每ID的v2是已知正確最新版，其中A的v2為撤銷。
knowledge.textEn: Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Five synthetic IDs each have v1 and v2, totaling ten distinct versions. A through D arrive v2 then v1; E arrives v1 then v2. Each v2 is the known latest version, including revoked A-v2.

steps.title: 固定版本鍵與來源政策 · 獨立重算基準
steps.titleEn: Pin version keys and provenance policy · Independently recalculate the baseline
steps.objective: 完成「固定版本鍵與來源政策」的獨立重算基準，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete independently recalculate the baseline for Pin version keys and provenance policy and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
本階段計算任務：情報接收端依到達順序覆寫同ID物件，較舊版本晚到後讓已撤銷的物件復活；本課建立可重放版本狀態機，另處理同鍵不同內容。 以物件ID加modified識別版本，固定來源身份政策，保存不可變歷史；對每次接收輸出advance、stale、duplicate或conflict決策及理由。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 為十個版本產生所有可行到達次序中的一組固定種子抽樣，逐次回放到空接收端，核對最終五個v2。用相同ID但不同modified確認新版本不被duplicate判定吞掉，並保留source_identity政策版本。
依此處給定的條件手算量綱及數值，再以獨立試算欄重算。先辨認本階段使用的是名義輸入、變更後輸入或驗收殘差，不要直接抄用原答案。判準：以物件ID加modified識別版本，固定來源身份政策，保存不可變歷史；對每次接收輸出advance、stale、duplicate或conflict決策及理由。
名義模型參考（輸入改變時須重新代入）：按到達覆寫只讓E保持v2，最新版正確率1/5=20%；按版本選擇五個都保持v2，正確率5/5=100%，四個陳舊到達不應倒退狀態。
steps.instructionEn:
Investigation calculation: An intelligence receiver overwrites objects by arrival order, letting a late older version revive a revoked object. Build a replayable version-state machine and separately quarantine different content claiming the same version key. Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Generate a fixed-seed sample of arrival permutations for the ten versions and replay each into an empty receiver, checking the same five v2 states. Verify that equal ID with different modified is a new version rather than a duplicate. Preserve source_identity policy version alongside every replay result.
Calculate with the conditions specified here, checking dimensions and repeating independently in a worksheet. Identify whether this investigation uses nominal inputs, changed inputs, or acceptance residuals; do not copy the baseline answer. Criterion: Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason.
Baseline model reference (substitute again when inputs change): Arrival-order replacement leaves only E at v2, giving latest-state correctness 1/5=20%. Version-aware selection retains v2 for all five, giving 5/5=100%; four stale arrivals must not regress state.
steps.observation: 兩種重算的差異有量綱與捨入說明。按到達覆寫只讓E保持v2，最新版正確率1/5=20%；按版本選擇五個都保持v2，正確率5/5=100%，四個陳舊到達不應倒退狀態。
steps.observationEn: The independent calculations reconcile with units and rounding accounted for. Arrival-order replacement leaves only E at v2, giving latest-state correctness 1/5=20%. Version-aware selection retains v2 for all five, giving 5/5=100%; four stale arrivals must not regress state.
steps.failure: 只複製同一公式兩次，未形成獨立核對；捨入掩蓋門檻差異。
steps.failureEn: Copying one formula twice instead of cross-checking independently, or rounding away a threshold difference.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: STIX 2.1定義物件版本與撤銷；本課衝突隔離為本地接收政策，並非用接收時間替代modified，也不以內容較長決定哪個版本可信。
knowledge.textEn: STIX 2.1 defines object versioning and revocation. Conflict quarantine is an explicit local receiver policy; arrival time must not replace modified, and longer content is not evidence that a competing version is trustworthy.

stages.description: 情報接收端依到達順序覆寫同ID物件，較舊版本晚到後讓已撤銷的物件復活；本課建立可重放版本狀態機，另處理同鍵不同內容。 以物件ID加modified識別版本，固定來源身份政策，保存不可變歷史；對每次接收輸出advance、stale、duplicate或conflict決策及理由。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 為十個版本產生所有可行到達次序中的一組固定種子抽樣，逐次回放到空接收端，核對最終五個v2。用相同ID但不同modified確認新版本不被duplicate判定吞掉，並保留source_identity政策版本。
stages.descriptionEn: An intelligence receiver overwrites objects by arrival order, letting a late older version revive a revoked object. Build a replayable version-state machine and separately quarantine different content claiming the same version key. Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Generate a fixed-seed sample of arrival permutations for the ten versions and replay each into an empty receiver, checking the same five v2 states. Verify that equal ID with different modified is a new version rather than a duplicate. Preserve source_identity policy version alongside every replay result.
